name: Close-Grip EZ-Bar Curl
description: The close-grip EZ-bar curl uses the inner grip position on an EZ-curl bar, which externally rotates the shoulders and shifts greater emphasis to the long head of the biceps. The long head contributes to the peak height of the bicep. The EZ-bar's angled grip reduces wrist strain compared to a straight close-grip barbell curl, making it more comfortable for high-volume training.

execution.starting_position: Stand holding an EZ-bar with hands on the inner (narrow) grip position, arms extended.
execution.setup_instructions: Use the inner grip knurling of the EZ-bar. Stand with feet hip-width, brace the core.
steps: Step 1: Curl the EZ-bar upward by flexing the elbows.
Step 2: Keep the upper arms stationary at the sides.
Step 3: Curl to full elbow flexion.
Step 4: Lower slowly to the starting position.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale on the curl, inhale on the return.
safety_considerations: EZ-bar reduces wrist stress — preferred over close-grip straight bar for comfort
coaching_cues: Long head focus — feel the stretch at the bottom
